title: まっ、流行ってすぐ変わるし！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: At the end of my day out with Tosen Jordan…

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Ughhh, I'm starving. Wanna get something to eat?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Heeeyo, girlio!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Fancy some Italiano? There's a really kickin' place nearby.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Itali…ano? Is that, like, good?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: For sure! Follow me! I'll show you a really happening spot! ☆

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Wow, this place has a cool vibe… Looks expensive, though!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: It's famous for its fantastic wines.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: They also have grape juice made from vineyard grapes. Want to try some?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Bet! I love grapes! Ah, but the price is probably outrageous…

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Hehe. ♪ Well, there certainly are expensive places, but…

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: The best part about Italiano is that, while it might look fancy, a lot of restaurants are pretty affordable and not super snobby.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: In other words, Italiano is hip for the modern youth! ♪ So let's enjoy!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: For real? Italiano is awesome! Sounds like I've got no choice but to stuff my face! ♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: The menu is on the wall over there. ♪

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Pizza, pasta… Seriously?! This is Italiano?! I know, like, all of this food!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Huh, you seem surprised… Did you not know we've been talking about Italian food?!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Phew! I'm stuffed! The pizza and the pasta were both great!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Nice call, Maruzen!
choice_data_list: You know some good places, huh?
You know some good places, huh?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Oh, it's nothing! I just know a thing or two about what's trendy!

text_block_list.name: Restaurant Owner
text_block_list.text: Haha, there was a time when we used to have TV interviews day after day.

text_block_list.name: Restaurant Owner
text_block_list.text: I think it's because we were so popular back in the day that I'm able to take my time and focus on my cooking now.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: That's right! Back in the…

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Back in the day? What about now?!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Jordan! Italiano is still super popular now, right?! Obviously tiramisu must be!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Huh? Umm… I don't really knooow…

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: But it's all good as long as the food is bussin', right?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Also, the pic I uploaded to Umasta got a ton of likes!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: That puts us, like, right on the forefront! It's like the times are catching up with Maruzen!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: The times are catching up with me?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Yeaaah! That's exactly what it means! ☆
choice_data_list: Aren't we getting a little carried away?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Of course! Maruzen is love, after all!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Hehehe! Great! Then I'm gonna keep running at the forefront of all the trends!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Full speed ahead!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Thanks to Tosen Jordan's assistance, the day is saved!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Huh? I don't think so. I just call it like I see it.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Hehe! Thanks, Jordan! Today was super far out!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: It's nothing… Ah, why don't we take a selfie? I wanna have something to remember this by!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Yeah, for shizzle!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Afterwards, their selfie goes viral and the "Italiano" restaurant suddenly becomes a hot spot.
